results.1-1: Lieutenant and their allies ambush the party (CP:R page 399).
results.2-2: Lieutenant is grappling a human shield (CP:R page 184).
results.3-3: Lieutenant orders their allies to focus on a particular player.
results.4-4: Lieutenant orders their allies to charge wildly at the party.
results.5-5: Lieutenant is in a highly defensible position, making use of cover.
results.6-6: Lieutenant has First Aid and Paramedic Skill Bases of 14 each.
results.7-7: Lieutenant has rigged an Armor-Piercing Grenade (CP:R page 345) as a trap before the combat, somewhere on the field. Noticing it requires a DV15 Perception Skill Check. Disarming it requires a DV9 Demolitions Skill Check. The grenade goes off if any Character moves into the square in which it is hidden.
results.8-8: Lieutenant has done extensive research into the combat capabilities of the party.
results.9-9: Lieutenant has a COOL of 6, a Reputation of 2, and attempts a Facedown. (CP:R page 194) either before combat begins or right at the beginning.
results.10-10: Lieutenant has a Tactics Skill Base of 16 and is in command.

results.1-1: Increase one of their Skill Bases that is above 10 to 17.
results.3-3: Give them Teamwork 3 (see CP:R page 153), and give them a Team Member of your choice.
results.4-4: Le Mini-boss est équipé d'une tenue pare-balles moyenne qui a été améliorée, supprimant la pénalité d'armure.
results.5-5: Le Mini-boss aura 600 ed de cyberimplants supplémentaire.
results.6-6: Le Mini-boss a une réputation de 5.
results.7-7: Give them an EMP Grenade (see CP:R page 345) and an Athletics Skill Base of 16.
results.8-8: Give them either a dose of Black Lace (see CP:R page 357) or Synthcoke (see CP:R page 358) before combat starts.
results.9-9: Increase their MOVE to 8 or increase their Evasion Skill Base to 18.
results.10-10: Give them Gills (see CP:R page 363) and a round of Exotic Bodysculpting (see CP:R page 226). Shark? Arowana? You decide.

results.1-1: Un sbire tire des munitions incendiaires (Page 346 du livre de règles), mais n'a que 10 balles.
results.2-2: Ajoutez 2 sbires supplémentaires à la rencontre au début du 2e round.
results.3-3: Deux sbires subissent actuellement l'effet principal de la Dentelle noire (Page 357 du livre de règles).
results.4-4: One Mook has an Armor-Piercing Grenade (CP:R page 345) and a Athletics Skill Base of 12.
results.5-5: One Mook is wearing Heavy Armorjack (SP13) Body Armor. Increase their REF, DEX, and MOVE by 2 (before calculating the Armor Penalty).
results.6-6: The Mooks are unusually organized. One Mook has a Tactics Skill Base of 13, and a Smoke Grenade (CP:R page 347).
results.7-7: Ajoutez un sbire supplémentaire d'un type différent lors de la rencontre.
results.8-8: Ajoutez 2 sbires à la rencontre. Ils auront toutefois une Blessure Critique à la tête chacun.
results.9-9: Ajoutez 1 sbire supplémentaire à la rencontre au début des rounds 2, 3 et 4.
results.10-10:
Un sbire a un pistolet-mitrailleur, aucun sens de l'auto-préservation, une base de compétence de Tir automatique de
16 et ne porte pas d'armure de tête.
